headword: {部分|ぶぶん}{日食|にっしょく}

definitions.explanation: A solar eclipse in which the Moon covers only part of the Sun's disk, so the Sun appears notched rather than fully hidden.

examples.japanese: {部分|ぶぶん}{日食|にっしょく}が{見|み}えた。
examples.english: A partial solar eclipse was visible.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{各地|かくち}で{部分|ぶぶん}{日食|にっしょく}が{観測|かんそく}された。
examples.english: A partial solar eclipse was observed in many places today.

examples.japanese: {部分|ぶぶん}{日食|にっしょく}でも、{太陽|たいよう}を{直接|ちょくせつ}{見|み}るのは{危険|きけん}だ。
examples.english: Even during a partial solar eclipse, looking directly at the sun is dangerous.

notes:
Composed of {部分|ぶぶん} (partial) + {日食|にっしょく} (solar eclipse).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {部分|ぶぶん}{日食|にっしょく}を{観測|かんそく}する: to observe a partial solar eclipse
- {部分|ぶぶん}{日食|にっしょく}が{見|み}られる: a partial solar eclipse can be seen

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {皆既|かいき}{日食|にっしょく}: total eclipse — the Sun is completely hidden
- {金環|きんかん}{日食|にっしょく}: annular eclipse — a ring of sunlight remains
